rationale: The assistant reached the right safety action, isolating at the consumer unit, by turn 2, and correctly linked the foam to the Fairy liquid. Its first reply was weaker: it suggested checking the seal, spray arms and hoses before knowing the cause, and it said 'water has reached your plug sockets', which the customer never said. It did not give practical next steps such as running rinse cycles once it was safe, or using only dishwasher detergent in future. It also had the customer mop up with only a caution about the sockets and did not first say to confirm the power is off. The escalation to the landlord and an electrician was appropriate, though telling the landlord to arrange an engineer or replacement is somewhat over-cautious.
